cohort: Preterm infants referred to a referral eye hospital in southeastern Iran, meeting specific criteria for birth weight and gestational age.
finding: Lower gestational age, lower birth weight, history of blood transfusion, and phototherapy were associated with ROP development, while phototherapy also decreased the need for ROP treatment.
birth_weight: Varied, including <= 2000 g and > 2000 g depending on gestational age criteria.
gest_age: Varied, including <= 34 weeks, between 34-37 weeks, and < 37 weeks depending on birth weight criteria.
